name: Launch Win-Back — Closed, No Purchase → Next Offer Re-Engagement
summary: Re-engages people who opted in during the launch and did not purchase by the time the doors closed. It starts on the truthful doors-close moment, offers the next approved offer, exits the instant the contact clicks, replies, buys or opts out, and sunsets non-responders so the list stays healthy. Everything is a draft; nothing sends or goes live.

audience.definition: Contacts on this launch's opt-in / registration segment who have no paid transaction line for any launch offer after launch_plan.launch_calendar.doors_close_at.
must_have: An approved launch opt-in / registration or lead tag for this launch
No launch buyer tag for this launch
No `sunset` or `launch-winback-sunset` state from an earlier win-back for the same launch
must_not_have: A paid transaction line for the main offer, any upsell or any downsell
An active abandoned-checkout recovery that is still inside its own window (that family owns the order recovery first)
DND / opt-out / unsubscribed from the broadcasting channel
audience.source: launch_plan.pages + launch_plan.email_sequences (opt-in segment) and launch_plan.automations (post_sale buyer tag). Buyer state is a verified paid transaction line, never merely a page visit.

trigger.primary_event: Launch closed and still no purchase — launch_plan.launch_calendar.doors_close_at has passed
trigger.ghl_trigger: Recurring / scheduled workflow that checks the launch segment against buyer state — not auto-built by CampaignBuilder; built with `caf workflows patch-trigger --trigger-json <file>` on the internal API (snapshot before write) or the Tier-4 managed browser (see U-GHL-PROBE)
trigger.start_rule: First run at least 1 day after doors_close_at, inside the 8 a.m.–9 p.m. recipient-local window; never before the calendar says the doors are actually closed.
entry_conditions: doors_close_at is in the past (truthful deadline from the launch plan)
Contact matches the launch opt-in segment
Contact has no verified paid line for any launch offer
Contact is not already `launch-winback-reengaged` or `launch-winback-sunset` for this launch
exit_conditions: Any click or reply → tag `launch-winback-reengaged`, remove `launch-winback-active`, route to the next offer / active broadcast
Any purchase → buyer suppression wins: end immediately, no promotional send, no further win-back
No response after the final takeaway → tag `launch-winback-sunset` and remove the launch broadcast tag
trigger.reentry: Once per contact per launch. A later distinct launch may enter again. Dedupe on tenant + launch_id + contact + action type — never on contact ID alone or on 'has tag'.
segmentation_inputs: A2P approved (SMS allowed) vs email only
Email + text launch vs email-only launch
Cold vs previously engaged (engagement only decides channel mix, never eligibility)

sequence.body_framework: If/Else on the launch buyer tag / verified paid line: TRUE → `workflow_goal` end (purchase stops every promotional win-back send). FALSE → continue. The same check runs before each later send so a purchase during the sequence stops the rest.
sequence.copy_notes: Purchase is the highest-priority exit. The buyer never receives win-back copy after paying.

sequence.step: 1 — Pattern interrupt: "The doors closed. Are we breaking up?"
sequence.subject_angle: "The doors closed — still a do-er… or a talker?"
sequence.body_framework: Short, personal, polarizing Us vs Them / Secret Telling hook. Name the honest fact that the launch closed and they did not join. One CTA: click to stay in the loop for the next offer. No fake deadline, no invented discount.
sequence.copy_notes: Copy angles come from the approved Skill 50 voice; this template wires them and does not author them.

sequence.subject_angle: "The one story everyone replied to — and your next invite"
sequence.body_framework: Lead with the single most entertaining story from the launch + the next approved offer. Future-pace the result they originally wanted. One CTA to the next offer / waitlist. No invented price — read offer price from the launch plan.
sequence.copy_notes: If the launch plan has no approved next offer, send value only and invite a reply; never invent an offer.

sequence.delay: +3 days; SMS on the same day, inside 8 a.m.–9 p.m. recipient-local
sequence.body_framework: Honest takeaway: one CTA to stay in the loop. SMS is one sentence with the same CTA, a reply invitation and STOP. Skipped entirely when launch_plan.a2p_ready is false or the launch is email-only; the build plan records the skip.
sequence.copy_notes: No invented deadline or consequence. The only truthful fact is that the launch closed.

sequence.body_framework: If no click, reply or purchase: add `launch-winback-sunset`, remove `launch-winback-active` and remove the launch broadcast tag so the contact drops out of launch promo sends. No further win-back for this launch.
sequence.copy_notes: Sunsets protect deliverability. They do not delete the contact and do not touch other launches.

ghl_build.engine: Skill 44 engine (caf / CampaignBuilder) — the official GHL API cannot create, update, publish or trigger a workflow (U-GHL-PROBE, 2026-10-20)

trigger_config.ghl_trigger: Recurring / scheduled segment check after doors close
trigger_config.build_note: CampaignBuilder only auto-creates a Tag Added trigger; use `caf workflows patch-trigger --trigger-json <file>` (snapshot before write) or the Tier-4 managed browser for the scheduled trigger. Calendar-date waits outside the API builder need the browser — keep the timing contract.

actions_in_order: 1. If/Else — launch buyer? TRUE -> workflow_goal end; FALSE -> continue
4. If/Else — buyer or re-engaged? TRUE -> end; FALSE -> continue
7. If/Else — buyer or re-engaged? TRUE -> end; FALSE -> continue
9. Send SMS — one-sentence nudge (step 3, skipped when a2p_ready is false)
11. Add tag `launch-winback-sunset`; remove `launch-winback-active` and the launch broadcast tag
ghl_build.goal_event: Click, reply, purchase or opt-out → `launch-winback-reengaged` (or buyer suppression) exits the workflow immediately.
ghl_build.notes: Duration waits only in the API builder; the doors-close date wait and any calendar-date trigger need the managed browser. Every step stays inactive until a separate client approval switches it live.

buyer_suppression.rule: A paid buyer receives no win-back or other promotional send for this launch, for any variant.
stops: This win-back workflow at every if/else
Remaining launch promotional emails and texts
Abandoned-checkout recovery and page-visit retargeting for the same offer
does_not_stop: The buyer's own onboarding / review / referral sequence
A genuinely different later offer approved in the launch plan

inputs_required: Launch opt-in / registration segment and launch buyer state
Approved next offer (name + URL) from the launch plan, or none (value-only variant)
Approved Skill 50 email copy hash and text copy (reply invitation + STOP)
launch_plan.a2p_ready and email-only vs email + text election
Location whitelist entry and Firebase refresh token (workflow writes); absent token → Tier-4 browser backstop

source.spec: launch-automations.spec.md §3.3 — 'Win-back | Launch closed, no purchase → re-engagement for next offer | re-engagement-winback-broadcast'
source.capability: 44-convert-and-flow-operator/automation-templates/launch-ghl-probe/GHL-CAPABILITY-NOTE.md — win-back: Skill 44 engine; recurring/scheduled trigger + last-open field check; scheduler triggers are not auto-built
source.fidelity_note: The 30-day-cold trigger and sunset suppression come from the existing broadcast template. This launch variant changes the audience to 'launch closed, no purchase' and the offer to the approved next offer; it does not invent prices, deadlines or discounts.

quality.wf_checks: WF-1..21 and FAB-QC >= 8.5 apply to the built workflow
assertions: Audience is closed-no-purchase: doors_close_at passed and no verified paid line
Buyer check runs before every send; any purchase ends the workflow
SMS is skipped entirely when a2p_ready is false; every text has a reply invitation and STOP
Non-responders get launch-winback-sunset and drop out of launch promo sends
Everything is draft_only; no live switch-on
No client account touched during the build

flexibility.principle: Recommended default, never a requirement. An explicit client request wins over this template.
flexibility.note: Only hard rules: draft_only, no sends before doors_close_at, and purchase always stops promotional sends.
